verses.text: Don't brag about tomorrow. You don't know what a day will bring.
Let somebody else praise you. Let it come from a stranger's lips, not your own.
Stone is heavy and sand weighs you down, but a fool's provocation is heavier than both.
Wrath is cruel and anger can overwhelm you, but who can stand up to jealousy?
Open correction is better than love kept hidden.
A friend's wounds can be trusted, while an enemy showers you with kisses.
When you're full, even honeycomb turns you off. When you're hungry, even bitter food tastes sweet.
Someone who wanders from home is like a bird that strays from its nest.
Perfume and incense lift your heart, and so does heartfelt advice from a friend.
Don't abandon your friend or your father's friend. When disaster hits, don't go to your brother's house. A neighbor nearby is better than a brother far away.
Be wise, my son, and make my heart glad. Then I can answer the person who taunts me.
A person with good judgment sees danger and takes cover. The inexperienced keep going and pay for it.
Take the coat of someone who guarantees a stranger's debt. Hold it as security for a wayward woman.
Shout a blessing at your neighbor first thing in the morning, and they'll take it as a curse.
A wife who's always picking fights is like a drip that never stops on a rainy day.
Trying to hold her back is like trying to hold back the wind or grip oil in your right hand.
Iron sharpens iron, and one person sharpens another. ⚒️
Tend a fig tree and you'll eat its fruit. Look after the person you serve and you'll be honored.
Water reflects your face. Your heart reflects who you are.
Sheol and Abaddon are never full, and people's eyes never get enough.
Silver is tested in a crucible and gold in a furnace. A person is tested by the praise they receive.
You could grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with the grain, and their foolishness would still be there.
Know how your flocks are doing and pay close attention to your herds.
Wealth doesn't last forever, and a crown doesn't stay in the family through every generation.
The hay is cleared, new grass comes up, and the grass on the hills is gathered in.
Your lambs provide clothes, and your goats can pay for a field.
You'll have plenty of goat's milk for yourself, your household, and the young women who serve you.
